title: Chimps Can Be Thieves, But They Hesitate to Rob Their Friends - Nautilus
gist: A study in Evolution and Human Behavior observed 26 chimpanzees at Uganda's Ngamba Island Chimpanzee Sanctuary and set up pineapple-theft trials between close friends and non-friends, finding chimps hesitate to steal from friends and friends forgive theft more readily.

insights.claim: Chimpanzees differentiate between friends and non-friends when deciding whom to steal food from, hesitating to rob close friends, according to a study in Evolution and Human Behavior.
insights.speaker: Devin Reese
insights.so_what: Evolutionary roots of in-group trust inform behavioral models of reciprocity and lending.
